items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: We had Jimmy Dorsey one time and Don Murray, who was a great saxophone.

ctx.x: How long did you play there?

Well, we went to work at, uh, well, we'd switched. First we went to work early, then we'd switch and went to work late. We'd get in there about, uh, ten o'clock. We'd be, we'd first, we'd went from eight until, uh, two. Then it changed the hours. The business picked up so good that we started going into ten and going through four and five in the morning. That's when we used to get good overtime. We made good money there. So then, that band broke up after so long, of time, and then, uh, I get the job at the…
How long was Muggsy with you there too?
